title.rendered: Return to In-Person Learning & SSD CLOUD at SSD Elementary schools

content.rendered:
Preparing to Return to In-Person Hybrid Instruction information – SSD website click HERE .

Sherwood elementary schools will begin In-Person learning on March 8th for Kindergarten and 1st grade students and on March 15th for 2nd grade through 5th grade students. Students will attend on a Ramp-up schedule the first two days of return to school where half the class will attend on Monday and the second half of the class on Tuesday with the entire class attending on Wednesday of their start week. Teachers will contact parents with student start days.

Those students moving to the CLOUD campus will be contacted by their CLOUD campus teacher to introduce themselves and to give CLOUD information.

School times for In-Person learning at the elementary level will begin at 7:55 am and end at 12:20 pm, Monday through Friday. We ask that students not arrive on campus before 7:45 am. Each class will have a snack and recess time during the school day. Students will eat lunch at home.

A free sack lunch and breakfast are available to all students for the remainder of the school year. Sack lunches with a breakfast, for the following day, will be delivered to classrooms prior to departure each day, for those students/families who order each morning.

Dates to note:

March 4th & 5th – Teacher Training – No School

March 12th – End of Trimester/Grading Day – No School

March 22nd – March 26th – Spring Break – No School
